body: Original production game artwork, transparent PNG, 4 columns x2 rows of EIGHT usable exterior views of ONE consistent logo-free fictional salvage road car in year2994 based on 2005 Chevrolet Corvette C6 BASE COUPE, NOT Z06 or Z51. Low sleek fiberglass two-seat sports coupe, fixed clear angular headlights (NO popup lights), long sculpted hood, low short cabin with closed solid removable targa roof, rear glass hatch, four separate round red taillights, subtle side gills. Muted lavender body, one cream replacement front fender, graphite lower trim, restrained rust-free fiberglass scuffs, no manufacturer emblems, badges, flags, letters or text. Exactly two long doors. No exaggerated aero, spoiler or widebody. Orthographic shallow elevated cameras with matched scale per slot. Top row FRONT, FRONT THREE QUARTER pointing nose RIGHT, LEFT SIDE pointing nose RIGHT, REAR THREE QUARTER pointing nose RIGHT. Bottom row REAR, REAR THREE QUARTER pointing nose LEFT, RIGHT SIDE pointing nose LEFT, FRONT THREE QUARTER pointing nose LEFT. Every car isolated centered entirely within its cell with generous clear gutters. ALL WHEELS AND TIRES REMOVED: empty transparent wheel arches so runtime adds wheels. Clean transparent background, no shadows, no scenery, no labels, no grids, no ground planes. Detailed painterly realistic game sprite, readable silhouettes.
dashboard: Original logo-free year2994 cockpit overlay game artwork, extremely wide 3:1 transparent PNG. View forward from left-hand drive 2005 Corvette C6 base coupe interior. Authentic low black molded dashboard, driver-oriented center stack with double rectangular air vents, blank simple radio, twin climate knobs, passenger grab handle, low windshield with raked A-pillars, small muted lavender and cream repaired trim details. NO steering wheel: leave it to runtime. NO gauges or digits: the driver cluster is ONE EMPTY BLACK recessed oval binnacle centered at27%ofimagewidth with broad clear region for live runtime gauges. No logos, emblems, letters, numbers or manufacturer symbols. Windshield sky and all outside area fully transparent; lower dashboard opaque to bottom edge. Close realistic driver-eye perspective, dashboard spans full width, no seats, no hands, no exterior scenery, no HUD. Detailed worn but usable 2994 salvage car, distinct 2005 sports car dashboard, not generic SUV.
